name: Banyan Tree Mayakoba

address.street: Carretera Federal Chetumal-Puerto Juárez KM 298 Riviera Maya

insider_take: This jungle-meets-ocean sanctuary sits within the exclusive Mayakoba resort complex, where ancient Mayan ruins peek through mangrove forests and cenotes create natural swimming holes just minutes from your villa.
whats_special: Each overwater and beachfront villa features its own private butler and infinity pool, while the resort's location within a 1,600-acre nature preserve means you'll spot exotic birds, iguanas, and even crocodiles from your terrace. The property's cenote-style spa treatments use ancient Mayan healing rituals in underground cave-like settings.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise yoga session on the floating platform—it's positioned perfectly over the lagoon where pink flamingos often make surprise appearances during morning meditation.
dont_miss: The guided kayak tour through the mangrove channels at sunset, where bioluminescent plankton light up your paddle strokes, and dinner at Sands restaurant with your feet literally in the sand while waves lap just meters away.
pros: Overwater villas with direct lagoon access
Award-winning spa treatments in private pavilions
Prime location within Riviera Maya's coastal ecosystem
